warnings: GRID-DEFINING SHEET: this plan is the source for dummy grids 3' (0.60 printed here) and A' (1.50/1.50 chain printed here), and carries the beams (B1, B2-vertical, B2-mid-bay) whose lines fix dummies 1'/1''/D' via A-04's printed dimensions -- see the grid master warnings for the full derivation, including the REVERSAL of Stage 0's '+1.50 m structural extension' reading (the 1.50 east line is a slab-only edge; the structural line is at 0.60).

Every beam endpoint on this sheet resolves to a named or dummy grid point -- no beam was dropped, given a prose-only position, or given start=end (the three §4 failure modes). The only non-column bearings are flagged bears_on_beam / beam-corner entries (B2 at D', B1, B2 at 1'', the A-1'' corner, and the A' porch frame).

Beam marks B1/B2/B3/B4/B5 + variants B3X/B4X/B5X: X-variant marks appear exactly where a beam runs into/beyond an edge condition (B4X = 0.60 stub off B4's line, B3X/B5X = dashed porch returns). Sections for all marks expected on S-07..S-10 -- spec join is Stage 2's job; no specs inlined here.
SI vs S1 checked per §10 at high zoom: the circled marks read SI (letter I). ST is drawn as a hexagon on this sheet (SI/SO in circles).

The 0.60 dimension printed below row B east of grid 3 measures from the grid-3 centreline to the OUTER face of the B2 edge beam / slab edge; the CN post centres scale to ~7.50 m. 3' recorded at the printed 7.60 with this noted (grid master carries the same flag).
No drawing break lines on this sheet (mandatory check done; see grid master).
